articles.title: Bloomberg Analyst: Most Bitcoin ETF Investors Have Stayed Put Despite Outflows
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETF investors have pulled billions this year, but the broader crypto ETF market remains more resilient than recent headlines suggest.

articles.title: FTX's Sam Bankman-Fried loses appeal of criminal conviction on fraud, conspiracy charges
articles.snippet: The onetime FTX CEO did not persuade a panel of judges that his trial was unfair, the appeals court panel ruled Friday.

articles.title: Former SEC, CFTC Chair Gary Gensler argues that prediction markets don't overrule state regulations
articles.snippet: The former regulator joined a number of interest groups in arguing that prediction markets are overstepping their bounds by offering sports-related contracts.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: SpaceX fuels tokenization’s next boom
articles.snippet: Tokenized RWAs surge despite crypto volatility, Kraken launches SpaceX IPO xStocks, prediction markets outpace onchain gambling and Sam Bankman-Fried seeks a Trump pardon.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner 'capitulation' comes as trader sees later 2026 bear-market bottom
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miner metic sparked talk of "capitulation" as profit margins stayed under 5%, but the BTC price bear-market bottom remained absent.
